# id: # S14 sweep (lane sweep/s14-map-iter, 2026-10-27; docs/defect-shapes.md §3 item 16; members BUG-005, BUG-088):
# the routes by which the body reaches the ranged map. Strict rows observe an order-invariant cut (a created
# entry's production folded into a bound check); membership rows carry the pick's latitude with members=.

subject: s14NestedDeleteOuterCurrent
why: a nested range over the SAME map whose inner loop deletes the outer's current key: the inner may produce that key before deleting it or not, at each of the three outer productions — inner total 4..6, admitted set {340, 350, 360} (members=3; gc exhibits all three); two in-flight mapIterK frames over one map, pick-next bound <= 3 candidates + stop

subject: s14NestedInsert
why: a nested range whose inner loop inserts key 11 whenever it ranges key 1: the outer may produce 11 or not (2 or 3 outer productions), the first inner may produce it or not, the later inners always do — admitted set {250, 260, 381, 391} (members=4; gc exhibits all four); pick-next bound <= 3 candidates + stop

subject: s14DeferLiteralMutatesMid
why: a deferred func literal deletes the next key in cyclic order when its enclosing literal returns, mid-iteration: the key deleted at the first production is unreached and never produced, the later deletes hit reached keys — admitted set {111, 1011, 1101} by which key came first (members=3; gc exhibits all three); pick-next bound <= 3 candidates + stop

subject: s14BareForm
why: `for range m` deleting key n at the n-th production: the deleted key may be the current one (three productions, len 0) or an unreached one (two productions, len 1) — admitted set {21, 30} (members=2; gc exhibits both); pick-next bound <= 3 candidates + stop

subject: s14SelfInsertBounded
why: a self-inserting loop bounded by the key (each production of k < 40 creates k+10): the chain of created entries may be cut at any created entry — admitted set {12, 23, 34, 45, 55} (members=5; gc exhibits all five); pick-next bound <= 1 candidate + stop
